scope: Public Svelte component and pattern exports from ts/src/components/index.ts and ts/src/patterns/index.ts. Utility and type-only exports are intentionally excluded from this batch.

decision.poodle_gap_rule: If a migration reveals missing primitive or generic composite behavior, add it to Poodle instead of preserving the gap inside a long-lived Underlay wrapper.
decision.poodle_ergonomics_rule: If a surface clearly belongs in a design system but Poodle's current API, styling constraints, or interaction model make common application workflows awkward, extend Poodle rather than retaining a second canonical Underlay implementation.

candidate_for_poodle_when: The surface is domain-neutral and can be named without Underlay portfolio nouns or workflow assumptions.
The surface represents a stable component contract rather than a product page assembly.
The surface is likely to recur across multiple apps and runtime targets.
The surface primarily expresses UI structure, interaction, accessibility, and theming.
The surface remains a Poodle candidate even when it needs contract, behavior, or styling improvement to fit everyday workflows cleanly.
keep_in_underlay_when: The surface is primarily a website shell, admin shell, operational flow, or product-oriented page composition.
The surface binds together generic parts with portfolio-specific workflow logic.
The surface carries auth-policy, recovery-flow, or other orchestration assumptions that are not clean design-system contracts.

keep_in_underlay.notes: Retain as a thin Underlay interaction shell for now. Poodle `Menu` is not yet a drop-in replacement for the live remaining callers because `DropdownMenu` still supports callback-oriented `items`, destructive row-action treatment, and arbitrary child-composed menu content used by `RowActionsCell`.

Retain as Underlay-owned structural shells, operational flows, or app-facing product composites. `PageHeader` is now reserved for richer section/title split, contextual-back, banner, and header-meta cases after the simple title/back/actions, count-bearing list headers, and plain upload/detail pages moved to Poodle `PageHeader`. `FormDialog` remains the flexible modal-form workflow shell for custom body/actions, but now resolves its close and status chrome through Poodle `IconButton` and `Callout` rather than a second local implementation. `RelationSelector` is now at its retained Underlay boundary: Poodle owns its dialog, search, status, button, and badge chrome, while Underlay keeps the actual relation filters, option list behavior, drilldown navigation, and selection workflow.

keep_in_underlay_after_assessment.notes: These are now settled retained Underlay workflow surfaces. Poodle ships adjacent generic components, but not drop-in replacements for Underlay's audit-log filtering and pagination model or its richer batch-selection workflow with select-all, status update, and registered action handling.

These are now settled retained Underlay auth and media surfaces. `MediaActionsMenu` and `MediaPicker` remain callback-driven media workflow shells rather than clean design-system composites. `AuthLayout`, `LoginPage`, and `ForgotPasswordFlow` remain the shared auth-flow shells, while `TotpInput` and `PasswordRequirements` remain shared auth field helpers with live use across login, recovery, and account-security pages.
This remains a small retained Underlay infrastructure surface. It still has live app-shell callers and encapsulates Svelte boundary recovery UI rather than a generic design-system primitive.
